caveat: Jumlah soal bukan satu-satunya KPI; mastery dan transfer lebih penting.

metrics.name: A/B/C/D per topic
metrics.purpose: Mengukur independensi dan dependency pada bantuan.
metrics.interpretation: A per-topic breakdown of A/B/C/D counts and shares. A high A-share within a topic signals independent mastery; a high C/D-share signals dependency on hints/editorial or unresolved gaps in that topic. Read per topic, not as a single aggregate number, and always alongside the §14.2 rule 7 caveat that problem count alone is not the KPI.

metrics.name: Time-to-first-correct
metrics.interpretation: Median and mean seconds to a learner's first accepted (AC) attempt at a problem. Lower is generally faster modeling/implementation, but must be read against problem difficulty and the learner's constraint-analysis time, not treated as a speed contest on its own.

metrics.name: WA/TLE/RE frequency
metrics.interpretation: Counts and shares (of total attempts) for the WA, TLE and RE verdicts specifically. A high WA share suggests logic/edge-case gaps; a high TLE share suggests complexity misjudgement; a high RE share suggests implementation/runtime hygiene gaps. Use to target postmortem focus, not to rank learners against each other.

metrics.name: Upsolve completion
metrics.interpretation: Share of records requiring a re-solve (resolveStatus scheduled/completed/overdue) that reached completed. A low rate signals the mandatory §14.2 rule 6 postmortem/upsolve obligation is not being followed through, independent of how many problems were attempted.

metrics.name: Repeat-solve retention
metrics.purpose: Memastikan solusi tidak hanya dihafal dari editorial.
metrics.interpretation: Of completed re-solves, the share solved cleanly (no hint, no editorial, verdict AC) on that later attempt. A low rate suggests the original solution was memorised from the editorial rather than internalised -- this is a DERIVED operational definition (§6.3 states only the intent, not a formula); see the docblock in src/domain/kpi.ts for the precise reading.

metrics.name: Complexity-selection accuracy
metrics.interpretation: PROXY, not a direct measurement: LearningRecord carries no explicit predicted-complexity field, so this uses the share of attempts that did NOT time out (verdict != TLE) as an observable stand-in for correct complexity selection. A platform that captures an explicit predicted-complexity field should override this metric with a direct comparison against required complexity rather than relying on the TLE proxy.

metrics.name: Contest time allocation
metrics.purpose: Menilai strategi pemilihan soal dan keputusan berhenti/pindah.
metrics.interpretation: The distribution (total, mean, median, max) of time spent per attempt, plus the share of total time spent on attempts that ended unsolved (status D). A high unsolved-time share suggests poor stop/switch decisions during contests; read alongside status-distribution rather than in isolation.
